name: dual-core-v2 population backend evaluation (src/virtual_cell/population_flow.py)
written_before: any single-cell feature, classifier score or flow prediction of this evaluation was computed. Known before: the Codex pilot of 2026-09-27 (A549, 24 h, 1 uM, 4 test groups: flow MMD 0.0356, mean-shift 0.0383, vehicle 0.0384, no uncertainty).
exposure: SciPlex3 is development data exposed since 2026-09-26 at the pseudobulk level; its single cells were used only by the Codex pilot (A549 24 h 1 uM).

data.conditions: 24 h, 10,000 nM, cell lines A549, K562, MCF7; every compound of outputs/biological_depth_20260926/prepared/compounds.csv
data.cells: up to 128 treated cells per (compound, line), seeded; vehicle cells of the same (line, plate) when at least 128 exist, otherwise of the same line; 512 vehicle cells per control group
data.features: the 2,473 prepared genes, log1p(counts x 10^4 / library over human genes); gene labels mapped with the prepared manifest's offset (as the Codex pilot)
data.basis: 32 principal components fitted on vehicle cells only (no treated cell, no label)

part1_decision_signal.question: Do observed single-cell distributions carry mechanism-class information beyond the pseudobulk mean shift?
part1_decision_signal.task: classify a held-out compound's mechanism class (klass) from its 3-line profile; classes with at least 3 labelled units; outer folds = registered folds

feature_sets.A_pseudobulk: gene-space mean shift (treated mean - matched vehicle mean) per line, 3 x 2,473
feature_sets.B_pseudobulk_plus_distribution: A plus per line: log(sd_treated / sd_vehicle) on 32 PCs, responder fraction (share of treated cells whose projection on the mean-shift direction exceeds the vehicle 95th percentile), energy distance to vehicle
feature_sets.D_pseudobulk_plus_abundance: A plus per line log(cells at 10 uM / cells at 10 nM) (a viability proxy, not a distribution feature; reported separately)
feature_sets.B_shuffled: B with the distribution block permuted across compounds within line (control)

part1_decision_signal.classifier: standardise features on training compounds; PCA to 64 dims on training compounds (A and B alike); multinomial logistic regression, C = 1, class_weight balanced; no tuning
part1_decision_signal.primary: B - A in per-compound log loss of the true class, unit mean, 10,000-draw unit bootstrap; population information adds decision signal only if the 95% interval is below 0
secondary: balanced accuracy and macro AUROC per set

part2_population_model.question: Does the conditional population flow predict held-out compounds' single-cell populations better than population-preserving baselines?
part2_population_model.split: registered folds by unit; within the training folds, one further fold (the next registered fold) is the flow's validation set for epoch selection
part2_population_model.populations: A549, K562, MCF7 at 24 h 10 uM: 64 vehicle and 64 treated cells per pair in the 32-PC basis
part2_population_model.condition_vector: 128-bit Morgan radius-2 fingerprint and a one-hot cell line; dose gate 1 (a single dose)

models.mean_shift: vehicle + mean training shift of that line
models.chemical_nn: vehicle + mean shift of the most Tanimoto-similar training compound(s) in that line
models.shift_scale_nn: vehicle cells centred, rescaled per PC by the nearest compound's sd ratio, and shifted by its mean shift (population-preserving with heterogeneity)
models.population_flow: src/virtual_cell/population_flow.fit_population_flow, default settings (80 epochs, 32 cells), epoch by validation MMD
models.oracle_mean: DIAGNOSTIC: vehicle + the observed mean shift of the held-out compound (reads outcomes)

part2_population_model.metrics: per pair: squared error of the mean (32 PCs), squared error of log sd ratios, MMD (bandwidth = median vehicle distance, fixed from training vehicle cells), energy distance; Hallmark gene-set score error of the decoded mean (PCA inverse); unit mean
part2_population_model.primary: population_flow minus each non-oracle baseline in unit-mean MMD, unit bootstrap 95% interval; the flow is better only if the interval is below 0 against every non-oracle baseline
part2_population_model.decision_link: only if part 1 finds population signal: whether the flow's predicted distribution features improve the part-1 classifier over pseudobulk-predicted features. Otherwise recorded as not supported by the data.

claims_not_allowed: that optimal-transport couplings are cell lineages
that numerical flow time is biological time
that a latent-space distance improvement is a biological or decision benefit
